# SupersDeck — reference

Everything the app exposes, read out of the code. If this disagrees with the
app, the app is right and this file is stale — regenerate it.

**Roles:** admin, manager, porter, super

## Permission groups

| group | roles | used for |
|---|---|---|
| `WRITE_ASM` | admin, super, manager | most writes |
| `WRITE_ASMP` | admin, super, manager, porter | work orders and heat-log entries |
| `ADMIN_ONLY` | admin | deletes and reference data |
| `CLOUD_ACCESS` | admin, super, manager | the cloud drive |
| `TENANT_PII` | admin, super | — |
